text: Coffee with Alessia. Her sister Giulia is pregnant again, due early March. Alessia's already knitting. Their mum is flying over from Turin sometime next week to help with the move, and Giulia's husband Matteo is between jobs, so it's a lot. Alessia wants to throw her a small baby shower around Feb 20. I said I'd help with invites.
Emre's puppy finally arrived, a beagle called Biscuit. Chewed through his charger on day one. He's taking her for jabs on Nov 4.

Long call with Fern. Her dad had his hip done last Thursday and is grumpy but walking. Her brother Tadhg is doing most of the driving. I should send Fern something for the weekend, she sounded wrecked.
Arturo and Francesca's christening for little Matteo is October 26th, 11am at St Anne's. Francesca's parents are doing lunch after. Need to find a card.
Lin said the cat (Mochi) has kidney trouble, vet recheck Nov 12. She's pretty upset. Check in with her before then.

Catch-up with Thabo at the school gates. His wife Lwazi starts maternity leave end of the month, baby due 12/2. He's painting the nursery this weekend and terrified of colours. Their older one, Ayo, wants a dog for Christmas, which is not happening apparently.
Nikhil's mum turns 70 on November 9th. He's planning a surprise dinner sometime early that week but hasn't booked anywhere. She loves Gujarati sweets, maybe bring a box.
Pick up dog food and the flea stuff. Pharmacy closes at 6.
Ellie told me Laila had the baby! Little girl, Fern, born Saturday. Both doing well. Don't forget to send Laila flowers once she's home, probably sometime next week.
Delroy's party for his dog Rex's 10th birthday is on the 2nd. Yes really. Cake for dogs and humans. I'm bringing the Bluetooth speaker.
Ran into Mrs Hughes. Her grandson Archie is starting nursery after half term and she's dreading the early mornings. Her husband's knee is bad again.
Gustavo said the baby shower for Marta got cancelled, she's on bed rest until the due date, Dec 18. He's doing all the cooking and sounds shattered. Remind me to drop round a lasagne for them.
Anil and his partner Sunil are adopting a rescue greyhound, collecting her Nov 1st. They've already bought three beds.
Mei mentioned she'd love a new pasta machine, her old one broke. Birthday's 1/15 I think.

Phoned Obi re the christening. His son Eli is being christened Sunday November 16, then food at Obi's in-laws'. Godparents are his brother Milan and Aisha from work. Milan is apparently nervous about the speech. Need to RSVP by Friday.
Francesca says Arturo's sister Angela just found out she's expecting twins. Shock all round. Scan was on 10/14, everything looked fine.
Giulia's cat went missing Tuesday night. Posters up. She's beside herself. Text her tomorrow to see if there's any news.
Elijah's new job at the vet practice starts June 3rd? No, he said January 3rd. Either way he's thrilled. His girlfriend Ebony is moving down with him over the summer.
Quick one. Jorge's wife had their baby boy last night, named him Elijah. Jorge sent a blurry photo at 4am. Must send a proper gift, not just a text.

Call with Aisha, mostly about her mum, who's had another fall and is now staying with Aisha's brother Obi for a few weeks. Aisha is driving up every weekend and clearly running on fumes. The hospital follow-up is 11/7. I should ring her the evening after to see how it went. Her own kids are being angels, she said, which helps.
Matteo Costa (Teo) is doing his first dog agility competition with Pepper on the 22nd. He's convinced she'll run off. Wish him luck that morning.
Haven't heard from Archie since his grandad's funeral last month. Should give him a call this week.

Ellie's brother Milan proposed to his girlfriend at the weekend. Engagement drinks are sometime mid November, date TBC. Ellie is organising, of course, and stressing about the guest list because their dad and his new wife will both be there. Milan's fiancee is lovely apparently, a nurse from Cork. Ask Ellie for the date once it's fixed.

Lunch with Ayo and Laila. Laila's twelve weeks, due early May, told her parents on Sunday and her dad cried. Ayo's dog Juno turns 1 on the 30th and he's planning a little party in the park. Laila says she'd love one of those baby memory books. Ayo's off to Lagos end of the month to see his grandma.
Note to self: vet for Smudge's booster, Oct 28 at 9:15. Then the car wash.
Lwazi is fine, just tired. Baby's kicking a lot. Thabo has stopped panicking about the nursery.
Sunil said Anil's dad passed away at the weekend. Funeral is next Thursday in Leicester. Anil hasn't said much. Don't forget to send a card to Anil, and maybe ask Sunil what would actually help.
Gustavo's girls are obsessed with the new kittens. They're called Salt and Pepper. Marta is not thrilled about the litter tray, given the pregnancy.

Fern and Tadhg are going to Galway for his mum's 60th, first weekend of December. They're taking the dog. She asked if I could water the plants and feed the fish while they're away. Tadhg's mum doesn't know about the party, so keep it quiet. Fern's thinking a framed family photo for her gift.

Drinks with Nikhil. His sister Angela got into the vet course she wanted, starts in September. His wife Lin is due on 4/20 with their second. Nikhil's boss approved his paternity leave, which was a relief. I need to send Angela congrats.
Ebony's hamster died. She's taking it surprisingly hard. Bring her chocolate tomorrow.
Ellie's grandad is in hospital with pneumonia, should be out sometime next week. She's travelling down Sunday.
Note: Delroy is allergic to cats. Do NOT bring him round when Mochi is visiting.

Elijah said his parents are getting a puppy, a cockapoo, collecting December 6th. His mum has already bought it a Christmas jumper. His dad pretends to be annoyed but has already built a gate for the stairs. Elijah's sister Ebony is coming home from uni for the weekend just to meet it.
Jorge's daughter Alessia had her first day at nursery today, he said she didn't even look back. He was the one crying.
Text from Marta: scan moved to Nov 3. Gustavo will drive her. She's nervous because of last time. Text her good luck the night before.
Emre's mum is in town till the end of the month. He wants us all for dinner sometime next week, probably Thursday. His brother is coming too.
Matteo and Giulia's anniversary is May 14. They're thinking Rome, sometime over the summer instead because of the baby.
Mei's dog Bao has to have a lump removed on the 9th. She's anxious but the vet thinks it's nothing. I'll ask her how it went on the 10th.

Popped in on Mrs Nowak downstairs. Her son Milan's wife is expecting, due end of February, first grandchild. She's crocheting a blanket and showed me about forty photos of the nursery. Her budgie has a cold, apparently.
Archie mentioned his dad retires on November 28th after 35 years at the council. Party at the rugby club that evening. Archie wants to get him a decent golf bag, asked if I'd chip in.

Big catch-up with Francesca. Christening went well despite Matteo screaming through the whole thing. Her mum loved the cake. Arturo is back at work Monday and dreading it. Francesca's thinking of going back part time in early March. She asked for the photos, need to send them.
Angela's partner Thabo was made redundant last week. They've got the twins on the way. She's putting a brave face on it. I should check in properly, not just a thumbs up.
Ayo's grandma passed peacefully on 10/18. He's flying to Lagos Wednesday for the burial. Message him before he goes.
Called the kennels about Christmas. Full 12/22 to 12/27. Try the one in Fernhill.
Laila said Ellie's struggling with the newborn, barely sleeping, and her partner went back to work already. Laila's going round on Saturday. I could drop off food sometime next week.
Tadhg's dog had puppies! Six of them, born on the 15th. He's keeping one and Fern wants another. Their kids are naming them after Pokemon.
Lin's sister Mei is getting married June 3rd in Singapore. Lin's flying out end of May with the baby. She's worried about the long flight.
Eli Moreau, Obi's son, turned two on Sunday. Obi says he's into dinosaurs and diggers, anything loud.

Gustavo's mum moved in with them over the summer, she's helping with the girls. Gustavo says she's taken over the kitchen entirely. Marta is fine with it now she's pregnant and can't face cooking. Their eldest, Laila, has a recital on Dec 12 and is practising piano every night.

Spoke to Delroy after his cat's op. Tiger came through fine, home with a cone on his head. Delroy's daughter Ebony is staying over to keep an eye on him. Follow up with Delroy end of the week about the stitches.
Remind me to ask Aisha what Obi's kids want for Christmas.
Sunil and Anil are hosting a gender reveal for Anil's sister on Nov 8th. I'm doing the cupcakes.
Elijah and Ebony's wedding is off. They split up in September, she's moved back to her mum's. Elijah seems ok-ish, throwing himself into work.

Matteo said his brother Gustavo's wife Marta had the baby early, 10/16, a boy. Both fine but the baby's in special care for a few days. Gustavo's exhausted, sleeping at the hospital. Matteo's taking their dog for the week. I must message Gustavo, and maybe send something for Marta once they're home, early next month probably.
Fern's son starts big school in September, she's already panicking about uniforms. Her mum is helping with pickups.
Dentist moved to 11/19, 2:30. Book the cat sitter for the 21st to the 24th while I'm in Leeds.
Mrs Olsen from the choir has a new rescue cat, Pudding, very shy. Her daughter Angela brought it round last Sunday.

Chat with Nikhil. Lin's doing well, the baby (Aisha) is sleeping through already, lucky them. His parents are visiting from Pune sometime in early December for the naming ceremony on Dec 7. His brother Sunil can't make it, stuck with work in Dubai. Nikhil wants help with the decorations.
Archie Fischer, Arch to everyone, got his puppy last week, a lab called Hops. Sleeping in a crate in the kitchen and howling all night. His girlfriend Lin is not amused.
